ITEM 1 | Long slender green spears, bright green with slightly darker tips, firm and smooth-skinned, cut ends at stem bottoms, about 15-18 cm long and roughly 1 cm thick, bundled together in a fan across the upper plate, dry surface with slight sheen, no visible browning or char | 90
ITEM 2 | Flat, pale green pod-like pieces, smooth and slightly glossy, about 6-7 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, one whole pod lying at left edge of the cluster, moist surface, firm texture, no cooking marks | 15
ITEM 3 | Pale yellow-green cubes of firm fruit or vegetable flesh, two or three visible pieces each about 2-2.5 cm across and 1.5-2 cm tall, smooth cut faces, slightly translucent edges, moist surface, holds its shape, sitting in the center-left of the leaves | 45
ITEM 4 | Mixed salad leaves in dark reddish-purple and deep maroon, ruffled and slightly glossy, some with wilted edges, covering roughly a third of the plate in the center and right, moist with a light sheen, soft but structured leaves, lying under and around the other items | 60
ITEM 5 | Bright and mid green tender leaves, flat and smooth, some with slightly crinkled edges, spread across the right and lower portion of the plate among the purple leaves, dry to slightly moist, no cooking marks | 35
ITEM 6 | Small sprigs of feathery dark green herb leaves with thin stems, located at upper right near the asparagus tips, about 4-5 cm across, dry and delicate, no sauce or oil visible | 5
